newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, slow downward journey.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, slow downward journey.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Tuesday but dealers said further erosion might be slow.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 3.75 points, or 0.28 percent, down at 1,339.93, after falling to 1,333.13, just above the year-low of 1,332.14 on September 10. Losers led gainers 169 to 65 in a trunover of 21 million shares, down from Monday's 27 million.
A correction before the close put a halt to a continuous slide and a major fall was avoided, a dealer at Kausar Abbas Bhayani Securities said.
